name: Musée National de Nouakchott
subtitle: National museum preserving prehistoric Neolithic artifacts and Saharan nomadic traditions.

facts.label: Collections

parts.text: The National Museum of Mauritania (Musée National de Nouakchott) offers an essential overview of Mauritania's ancient and nomadic heritage. Across two exhibition floors, the museum presents Stone Age tools from the Sahara, pottery from medieval caravan towns such as Koumbi Saleh, Chinguetti, and Ouadane, and ethnographic collections showcasing traditional nomadic tents, leatherwork, and musical instruments.
